create_session_source_roundtrip: create a SessionSource and serialize it to dict then restore with from_dict preserving all fields
build_session_context_prompt: build a session context prompt from a SessionSource and GatewayConfig for a given platform
build_session_key: build a session key from a SessionSource with per-user isolation for groups and threads
test_session_store_rewrite_transcript: test that SessionStore.rewrite_transcript replaces JSONL transcript with truncated history
test_session_store_load_transcript_corru: test that SessionStore.load_transcript skips corrupt JSONL lines instead of crashing
test_session_store_load_transcript_prefe: test that SessionStore.load_transcript prefers the source with more messages
test_session_store_switch_session: test that SessionStore.switch_session ends the current session and resumes the target session
test_session_store_session_key_consisten: test that session keys are consistent across WhatsApp DMs, Telegram DMs, and Discord groups
test_session_store_entries_attribute: test that SessionStore uses _entries attribute instead of _sessions
test_session_store_has_any_sessions: test that SessionStore.has_any_sessions uses database count when available
test_session_store_update_session_last_p: test that SessionStore.update_session sets last_prompt_tokens on a session entry
test_rewrite_transcript_preserves_reason: test that rewrite_transcript preserves reasoning, reasoning_details, and codex_reasoning_items
